# Admin audit log

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P1 · Who did it](../README.md#phase-1--who-did-it) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:admin-audit-log` · **Epic:** [#37](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/37) · **Tickets:** 3 (1S 2M)

Every change made through the CP console or API is recorded with who did it, what changed, and the state hashes before and after. Entries are hash-chained and signed with the existing Ed25519 receipt machinery. Admins can view and verify the log in the dashboard, and each entry is also emitted as a JSON log line for the SIEM.

## How we build it

- cpstate table `admin_audit(id, ts, actor_sub, actor_email, actor_role, auth_method[oidc|breakglass|cli|worker_token], action, target, outcome[ok|denied|error], before_hash, after_hash, client_ip, request_id, prev_hash, entry_hash, signature)`. The table is append-only, and no update or delete path exists in code.
- Signing reuses `internal/audit.Signer`. A new `SignBytes(b []byte)` covers canonical JSON of the entry minus signature. The key is `<state-dir>/cp-audit.key`, loaded or created through the same PKCS#8 helper pattern as worker `loadOrCreateSigner`. The public key is shown in the dashboard and served at `GET /dashboard/api/admin-audit/pubkey`.
- Hash chain: entry_hash = sha256(prev_hash || canonical entry). Verification walks the chain and checks every signature.
- Capture point: middleware on the CP mux records every non-GET request, including denied ones, after the authz check. Action names come from the authz route table. before_hash and after_hash come from per-target state hashers (policy -> current policy version/ETag, integrations -> sha256 of the integrations block, tokens/blocklist -> row hash), so no payload bodies or secret values are stored.
- Each entry is also logged as `slog` JSON with `msg=admin_audit` and `schema=warden.admin.v1` to the CP logger and to the JSON audit sink when one is configured.

## Done when

Editing policy, integrations, worker tokens or the block list produces signed, chained audit rows with actor and before/after hashes, which an admin can list and verify in the dashboard. A tampered row fails verification.

### 1/3 · W-P1-AAUD-01

**Add signed, hash-chained admin audit store in cpstate**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#38](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/38)

Add `audit.Signer.SignBytes` and `audit.VerifyBytes` to `internal/audit/receipt.go` without changing `Sign(event)` output. Add the `admin_audit` migration and an `AdminAuditStore` (Append, List(filter, limit, cursor), Verify(from,to)) in internal/controlplane on top of cpstate. Append serializes on a mutex to keep the chain linear. Load or create the CP audit key at `<state-dir>/cp-audit.key` (0600).

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Appending 1000 entries concurrently yields a valid chain
- [ ] Changing any column of a stored row makes Verify report that row id
- [ ] Existing worker receipt tests pass unchanged

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-SSO-01`](console-sso-rbac.md#16--w-p1-sso-01) Add internal/cpstate SQLite state store with migrations

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-AAUD-02`](admin-audit-log.md#23--w-p1-aaud-02) Record every CP mutation via audit middleware with state hashers

### 2/3 · W-P1-AAUD-02

**Record every CP mutation via audit middleware with state hashers**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#39](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/39)

Wrap the CP mux in middleware that runs for non-GET methods. It takes the Principal from context, the action/target from the authz route table, and calls the registered `StateHasher` for that target before and after the handler (policy, settings, integrations, detection, llmproviders, secrets key metadata, worker tokens, blocked users). It records outcome from the response status, including 403s, and emits the `admin_audit` slog line. Request bodies are never read by the middleware.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] A table test hits every mutating route and expects exactly one audit row with the correct action
- [ ] A viewer's denied POST is recorded with outcome=denied
- [ ] A test asserts that a secret value POSTed to /central/secrets appears in neither the audit row nor the log line

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-AAUD-01`](admin-audit-log.md#13--w-p1-aaud-01) Add signed, hash-chained admin audit store in cpstate; [`W-P1-SSO-05`](console-sso-rbac.md#56--w-p1-sso-05) Map groups to roles and enforce role checks on dashboard APIs

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-AAUD-03`](admin-audit-log.md#33--w-p1-aaud-03) Show admin audit log and chain verification in the dashboard; [`W-P1-PVER-03`](policy-versioning.md#34--w-p1-pver-03) Add policy history, structural diff and rollback APIs; [`W-P1-BLOCK-03`](user-block-list.md#33--w-p1-block-03) Add CP block-list store, admin API and dashboard UI; [`W-P1-WTOK-03`](worker-credentials.md#34--w-p1-wtok-03) Add worker token admin API, dashboard panel and bootstrap CLI; [`W-P1-OPS1-01`](ops-hardening.md#13--w-p1-ops1-01) Add break-glass local admin with alerting and audit; [`W-P1-JAUD-03`](audit-log-export.md#34--w-p1-jaud-03) Route CP admin audit lines to the JSON audit writer

### 3/3 · W-P1-AAUD-03

**Show admin audit log and chain verification in the dashboard**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#40](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/40)

Add `GET /dashboard/api/admin-audit?actor=&action=&since=&cursor=` (admin role), `POST /dashboard/api/admin-audit/verify` (returns `{ok, checked, firstBadId}`) and `GET /dashboard/api/admin-audit/pubkey`. Add an 'Admin log' tab to `internal/dashboard/index.html` with filters and a verify button. The tab is wired only on the CP, through a `SetAdminAudit` setter, and workers get 404.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] An admin sees entries newest-first with paging, and a viewer gets 403
- [ ] Verify on an untouched DB returns ok with checked equal to the row count

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-AAUD-02`](admin-audit-log.md#23--w-p1-aaud-02) Record every CP mutation via audit middleware with state hashers
